name: Odyssey
source:
Did you hear about that house that burned down a few summers ago? 

Yeah, the house up on the hill, with the dirty picket fence. They said there was no survivors, but only two bodies were ever found in the rubble. There was five up there, don't you know? And they were the parents, too. Not just that, it was the Alitrixes. Plenty of reason to burn the place down, I know- but hey, I heard they were getting... better. But the funny thing was that one of them did pyromancy! The little girl, with the crutches. Heard she was a trouble maker of some sort. And for the house to just catch fire like that? No evidence of a gas leak or accident, but they did find a bunch of moth balls in the basement, and I mean a LOT. I'd say the girl set the place ablaze, but that's just me.

That still doesn't explain the bodies, though. News said the house was up and burning in the middle of the night, that's why it took the fire department so long to get down there- there's no  way they would've gotten out if they didn't know. Or if at least one of them didn't know.

...So where are they?

[From [url=https://ssspacecadet.itch.io/odysseydemo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你听说过几年前夏天烧毁的那所房子吗？

是的，山上的房子，有肮脏的尖桩篱笆。他们说没有幸存者，但在废墟中只发现了两具尸体。上面有五个人，你知道吗？他们也是父母。不仅如此，还有Alitrixes。我知道有很多理由烧毁这个地方——但是嘿，我听说他们正在变得……更好。但有趣的是，其中一个竟然会火术！小女孩，拄着拐杖。听说她是个麻烦制造者。房子就这样着火了？没有煤气泄漏或事故的证据，但他们确实在地下室发现了一堆樟脑丸，我的意思是很多。我想说是那个女孩放火烧了这个地方，但那只是我。

但这仍然无法解释尸体。新闻称房子在半夜着火了，这就是为什么消防队花了这么长时间才到达那里——如果他们不知道的话，他们根本不可能逃出去。或者如果他们中至少有一个人不知道的话。

……那么他们在哪里？
